text: Charged twice for my last order (#88213). I checked and five other customers in the shop's review thread say the same thing happened this morning. The payment provider's status page lists an open incident for card payments.
Hi, small thing. After I logged in just now, the "my orders" page showed a different name and a list of orders that are not mine, with their delivery addresses. I logged out straight away.

We are a trade customer. Since 9 this morning our warehouse scanners cannot connect to your order sync, and 40 of our orders are stuck. Our trucks arrive at 4 pm and we cannot load without the pick lists.
The phone charger I bought from you got very hot overnight and melted the plug and the socket. I have photos. My daughter's bed is next to that socket. I have stopped using it.
Hi, the password reset email never arrives for me. Tried a few times. A colleague says the same. We use the account for a subscription, no idea when it renews.
Following up again on the $2,300 refund for our business order. You said it was approved a few weeks ago and my bank has not shown it yet. Could you check when it will arrive?
The code SAVE90 was posted on a public deals forum this morning. It is stacking on top of sale prices, and I can see 11 orders at about 90% off in the last hour. Thought you would want to know.
The invoice PDF I downloaded has another company's name, address and tax number on it instead of mine. The order number is mine. My accountant says we cannot use it.
Our broker mentioned the paperwork for our 300 unit order may be missing a safety certificate. Could you send over whatever you have on file when you get a chance? Delivery is due soon.
Two of my friends and I all saw card charges we did not make, in the days after ordering from your shop. All three of us used the same site. The bank has cancelled our cards.
The checkout is showing the $49 jacket for $0.49. I just bought three. I am telling you because it looks like a mistake.
I asked on the 3rd for my account and data to be deleted. The form said done, but my login still seems to work. Is that expected? Thanks.
Hello, I ordered a blue scarf by mistake and want to change the shipping address on the same order before it is sent. The new address is below. Thank you!
My order arrived with the box crushed on one corner and the bag inside a bit creased. It is still usable. Could you tell me whether this happens often with your carrier? I am quite upset about it.
Could you send me a copy of the invoice for my order from last month? I need it for my expenses.
I noticed a typo on your About page: "recieve" in the second paragraph. Lovely shop otherwise!
Do you offer gift wrapping, and does it cost extra? It is for a birthday in two weeks.
THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE!! My parcel is two days late. The tracking page says it left the depot this morning and is out for delivery.
I have asked THREE TIMES to be taken off your newsletter list and the emails keep coming. This is harassment. Please remove me from the list today.
What is the best way to wash the wool sweater I bought? The label has worn off.
URGENT: my 5% welcome code expired yesterday and I want it extended today or I will leave a one-star review.
Your site is great. It would be nice to have a dark mode for evening browsing. Just a suggestion.
Someone has my old surname and email on file and I need them changed urgently. I think the old email may be in other lists too. Can you update my account name and email?
The shoes I bought gave me a blister on the first wear. Nothing serious, it has healed. How long do I have to return them? I bought them 12 days ago.
